definitions.explanation: Describing something emotionally or physically difficult to endure. Expresses suffering or hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{辛|つら}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.notes: Expressing that work is difficult to endure

examples.japanese: ⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{辛|つら}かった。
{辛|つら}いこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If something difficult happens, please talk to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{辛|つら}い⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えないで→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Please don't keep your painful feelings to yourself. It's important to talk to someone.

notes:
{辛|つら}い describes something emotionally or physically painful and hard to endure. It is broader than ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ (physical pain) and more personal than ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧ (tough, a lot of work): ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧ describes the situation, {辛|つら}い how it feels to the person going through it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辛|つら}い⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: a painful experience
- {辛|つら}い⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go through a hard time
- {辛|つら}い⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: a hard period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧: suffering under strain, physical (breathing, pain) or financial (⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧). {辛|つら}い is the general word for emotional hardship.

FORMS:
- After a verb stem, -⟦づらい→〜づらい：18368_zurai⟧ means "hard to do" from the doer's side: ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦づらい→〜づらい：18368_zurai⟧ (hard to say), ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦づらい→〜づらい：18368_zurai⟧ (hard to read).

WRITING:
The same kanji is read {辛|から}い (spicy, hot). To avoid the ambiguity, つらい is often written in kana.
